Ben H.: Customer cust-507 pinged support about a surprising line on INV-6450 — looks like ~7,350 burst tokens were billed in both eu-west-1 and eu-central-1 for the same minute ranges. invoice: https://invoices.redwood/inv_6450.pdf :frowning:
Sofia M.: Can you dump the condensed lines? which billing window?
Ben H.: Window 2026-06-15 -> 2026-07-14. Condensed CSV from billing repro: ```line_item_id,desc,region,nodepool,committed,used,burst,amount
E5001,Reserved commit - eu-west-1,eu-west-1,eu-west-main,90000,89000,0,4500.00
E5002,Burst usage - eu-west-1,eu-west-1,eu-west-main,90000,7350,7350,367.50
E5003,Burst usage - eu-central-1,eu-central-1,eu-central-standby,0,7350,7350,367.50
E5004,Reserved commit - eu-central-1,eu-central-1,eu-central-standby,40000,39200,0,2000.00
``` So customer sees duplicated burst ~367.50 USD.
billing-ops-bot: Metering event mp-eu-211: 2026-06-27T04:05:14Z - live failover triggered for cust-507. Failover duration 00:12:46. Logs: /meters/mp-eu-211.log
Tariq A.: Runtime note: the metering-proxy re-assigned tags during failover and we currently don't persist origin_tag. That can cause billing to record both original and failover pools as billable.
metering-bot: Token mirror detected for cust-507 between eu-west-1 and eu-central-1. Mirror start 2026-06-27T04:03:00Z, stop 2026-06-27T04:15:46Z. Mirror mode: failover.
Sofia M.: Policy: if duplication is internal (our routing/mirroring) and tokens are identical, we provide full duplicated-burst credit plus a 5% goodwill on next invoice. Need three artifacts: (1) token-hash dedupe showing identical token ids in same UTC windows, (2) mapping of both line items to cust-507, (3) failover logs showing tag re-assignment.
Ben H.: I've created billing case BILL-2026-389 and uploaded condensed CSV and failover logs. Token export job started: /exports/cust-507/20260627_tokens.csv (ETA 3h). Placed INV-6450 on provisional hold until 2026-07-05.
Clara (Finance): Finance provisionally approves up to $450 credit for duplicated burst pending token dedupe. Use JE code 3-400-BILL and memo "dup burst credit cust-507". Final amount subject to dedupe confirmation.
Tariq A.: Product/Infra follow-up: we should persist an ingress origin_tag across proxy handoffs to avoid re-tagging during failovers. Filing INFRA-833 to add origin_tag persistence. ETA 12 days.
Sofia M.: Next steps: (a) devops to confirm token dedupe and produce per-token hashes, (b) billing to request vendor reclassification of E5003 as non-billable if vendor is the source, (c) finance to prepare provisional JE. Target resolution: 2026-07-04.
billing-ops-bot: Token dedupe job queued. Status: running. Output path: /exports/cust-507/dedupe_report_20260627.json
Ben H.: I'll update the customer thread with a provisional note once dedupe completes and we have a proposed credit. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
